# iPod.js (local files)

> An iPod Classic simulator for the web that plays music from a folder on the user's own computer. It runs entirely in the browser: there is no server, no account, and no music is uploaded.

- Source code: https://github.com/Gitguy268/ipod
- Based on: https://github.com/tvillarete/ipod-classic-js (MIT)

## What it does

- Reads a chosen folder and its subfolders for mp3, m4a, aac, flac, wav, ogg, opus and aiff files.
- Groups songs into artists, albums, genres and playlists (.m3u) from their tags, falling back to folder names.
- Shows album artwork embedded in the files or stored beside them.
- Three display modes: a compact mini player, the full iPod, and a window-filling view.

## Browser support

- Chrome and Edge remember the chosen folder between visits.
- Safari, Firefox and Brave need the folder chosen (or dragged in) on each visit.
